content.title: Federal tax return extensions | USAGov
content.text: Skip to main content Federal tax return extensions A tax return extension gives you six more months to file, but you must still pay your taxes on time. Learn about tax return extensions or how to pay your tax bill in installments. How to file for a tax extensionWhile you will get more time to file your return, an extension does not grant you more time to pay your taxes. To avoid possible penalties, you should estimate and pay your federal taxes by the due date. Learn the ways to request an extension:Online using IRS Free FileWhen you pay your estimated tax billUsing IRS Form 4868How to pay taxes in installmentsIf you feel that you may not be able to pay your tax bill in full by the due date, you may be eligible to pay in installments. Learn more about the IRS’ payment plans and what additional costs and fees you may have to pay. LAST UPDATED: December 22, 2025 SHARE THIS PAGE: Have a question?
